name: dairy-herd-android
description: Android (APK) build of Dairy Herd. The app itself lives one folder up; this wraps it with Capacitor.

scripts.sync: npm run web && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk:debug: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
